import json,sys
from pathlib import Path,PurePosixPath
sys.path.insert(0,r'C:\Users\stop-\n1-kanji-workspace\review-tools')
from common import WS,freeze_json,frozen,require,sha,start_guard,write_frozen
from verify_b130_sources import Git
here=WS/'scratch-131'/'review'
repo=WS/'b131-worktree'
source=repo/'docs'/'n1-sources'/'batch-131'/'base-adaptation.json'
raw=source.read_bytes(); data=json.loads(raw)
old='6da1184b82b60553f9b65c57f53289c779f96f7c'; new='cb0f5581bdda84f7e673225c19126c85e242e57b'
proof=json.loads(frozen(here/'incoming-main-verification-001.json','0448941d3d420612eb6bc07a1c677a15c06ee72e0786d4d9e3eb1c5dcf578f3e'))
require(data['originalSourceBase']==old and data['candidateBase']==new and data['method']=='ordinary git merge --ff-only','Adaptation identity differs')
require(data['coordinatorProofSha256']=='0448941d3d420612eb6bc07a1c677a15c06ee72e0786d4d9e3eb1c5dcf578f3e' and data['coordinatorAddendumSha256']=='f88e6d83a997a7a608359f84b7e95b20521095173aa8640a1221dc21db0d53a0','Adaptation inputs differ')
require(set(data['incomingPaths'])==set(proof['addedPaths']+proof['modifiedPaths']) and not set(data['incomingPaths']) & set(data['localTrackedPathsBefore']),'Incoming and author paths overlap')
guard,_=start_guard('B131 explicit author baseline adaptation observation')
runner={'path':str(here/'guarded-test-v3.py'),'sha256':'da78564efadb90ac4c174dbf13e375327b611bc5e0fc77913c8b85c22c1aaf6b'}
git=Git(repo,runner,guard)
try:
    require(git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==new,'Author HEAD differs from adapted baseline')
    before=git('ls-tree','-rz','--full-tree',old,'--','kanji')
    after=git('ls-tree','-rz','--full-tree',new,'--','kanji')
    require(before==after and len([entry for entry in before.split(b'\0') if entry])==1254,'Complete baseline kanji tree differs')
    prefix=repo/'docs'/'n1-sources'/'batch-131'
    for name,digest in data['originalScans'].items():
        path=prefix.joinpath(*PurePosixPath(name).parts).resolve()
        require(path.is_relative_to(prefix.resolve()),'Scan escapes its prefix')
        require(sha(path.read_bytes())==digest,'Original scan bytes changed: '+name)
        guard.check()
    comparison_prefix='docs/n1-sources/batch-131/comparison-cards/'
    comparisons={path:digest for path,digest in data['localPathHashesPreserved'].items() if path.startswith(comparison_prefix)}
    require(comparisons,'Missing exact comparison copies')
    names=list(comparisons)
    objects=git.objects([new+':kanji/'+PurePosixPath(path).name for path in names])
    for path,(_,blob) in zip(names,objects):
        local=repo.joinpath(*PurePosixPath(path).parts).resolve()
        require(local.is_relative_to((prefix/'comparison-cards').resolve()),'Comparison escapes its prefix')
        require(local.read_bytes()==blob and sha(blob)==comparisons[path],'Comparison binding differs: '+path)
        guard.check()
    require(data['baselineManifestSha256']==proof['manifestSha256'] and data['baselineContentVersion']==proof['contentVersion'],'New manifest binding differs')
    require(source.read_bytes()==raw and git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==new,'Observation changed during reading')
    captured=write_frozen(here/'author-base-adaptation-observed-001.json',raw)
finally:
    memory=guard.finish()
require(not memory['breach'],'Adaptation observation RAM breach')
print(json.dumps(freeze_json(here/'author-base-adaptation-verification-001.json',{'status':'PASS_EXPLICIT_BASE_BINDING_OBSERVATION_ONLY','originalBase':old,'observedAuthorBase':new,'authorRecord':captured,'baselineKanjiEntries':1254,'baselineKanjiTreesEqual':True,'preservedOriginalScans':len(data['originalScans']),'exactComparisonCopiesAtNewBase':len(comparisons),'authorReportedLocalFilesPreserved':len(data['localPathHashesPreserved']),'incomingAndAuthorTrackedPathsDisjoint':True,'memory':memory,'limits':'Read-only observation during active authoring. No signing or clean candidate asserted. All215 pre/post local-file hashes were recorded by the author, not independently sampled at the earlier fast-forward instant. Current runtime draft content, source completeness, scans semantic coverage and final gates remain unaccepted.'})))
cleanupScope: Immediate child PID only; not descendant-process acceptance.

memory.peakScope: Verifier Python process, including its monitor thread; not subprocess peaks.
memory.additionalChecks: Before each file and each streamed chunk; signal interruption on a sampled breach.
